import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Scanner;
import java.util.Set;

public class ProblemE {
    public static int width, height;
    public static final int INF = 9999999;
    public static Set<Integer> masks = new HashSet<Integer>();
    
    public static void dfs(int col, int row, int mask) {
        if (col >= width) {
            masks.add(mask);
            return;
        }
        // always set bit at col+width
        dfs(col+1, row, mask | (1 << (col + width)));
        // other conditions in different order
        if (row >= 1) {
            dfs(col+1, row, mask | (1 << col));
        }
        if (row <= height - 2) {
            dfs(col+1, row, mask | (1 << (col + 2*width)));
        }
        if (col >= 1) {
            dfs(col+1, row, mask | (1 << ((col-1) + width)));
        }
        if (col <= width - 2) {
            dfs(col+1, row, mask | (1 << ((col+1) + width)));
        }
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String[] parts = scanner.nextLine().split(" ");
        width = Integer.parseInt(parts[0]);
        height = Integer.parseInt(parts[1]);
        if (width > height) {
            int tmp = width;
            width = height;
            height = tmp;
        }
        int states = 1 << (width * 3);
        int[][] dp = new int[height+1][states];
        for (int i = 0; i <= height; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < states; j++) {
                dp[i][j] = INF;
            }
        }
        dp[0][0] = 0;
        
        int limit = 1 << (width * 2);
        for (int i = 0; i < height; i++) {
            masks.clear();
            dfs(0, i, 0);
            int j = 0;
            while (j < limit) {
                if (dp[i][j] != INF) {
                    for (int res : masks) {
                        int next = res | j;
                        int nextn = next >> width;
                        int add = Integer.bitCount(next & ((1 << width) - 1));
                        if (dp[i+1][nextn] > dp[i][j] + add) {
                            dp[i+1][nextn] = dp[i][j] + add;
                        }
                    }
                }
                j++;
            }
        }
        
        int answer = INF;
        int j = 0;
        while (j < limit) {
            int val = dp[height][j] + Integer.bitCount(j);
            if (val < answer) answer = val;
            j++;
        }
        System.out.println(height * width - answer);
    }
}

import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Scanner;
import java.util.Set;

public class ProblemE {
    public static int w, h;
    public static final int MAX = 9999999;
    public static Set<Integer> result = new HashSet<Integer>();
    
    public static void dfsIterative(int startN, int m) {
        ArrayList<int[]> stack = new ArrayList<int[]>();
        stack.add(new int[]{startN, 0});
        while (!stack.isEmpty()) {
            int[] state = stack.remove(stack.size() - 1);
            int n = state[0];
            int mask = state[1];
            if (n >= w) {
                result.add(mask);
                continue;
            }
            // push in reverse order to simulate original recursion order
            stack.add(new int[]{n+1, mask | (1 << (n + w))});
            if (n <= w - 2) {
                stack.add(new int[]{n+1, mask | (1 << ((n+1) + w))});
            }
            if (n >= 1) {
                stack.add(new int[]{n+1, mask | (1 << ((n-1) + w))});
            }
            if (m <= h - 2) {
                stack.add(new int[]{n+1, mask | (1 << (n + 2*w))});
            }
            if (m >= 1) {
                stack.add(new int[]{n+1, mask | (1 << n)});
            }
        }
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        Scanner s = new Scanner(System.in);
        String[] line = s.nextLine().split(" ");
        w = Integer.valueOf(line[0]);
        h = Integer.valueOf(line[1]);
        if (w > h) {
            int tmp = w;
            w = h;
            h = tmp;
        }
    
        int[][] dp = new int[h+1][1<<(w*3)];
        for (int i = 0 ; i <= h ; i++) {
            for (int j = 0 ; j < 1<<(w*3) ; j++) {
                dp[i][j] = MAX;
            }
        }
        dp[0][0] = 0;
        
        for (int i = 0 ; i < h ; i++) {
            result.clear();
            dfsIterative(0, i);
            for (int j = 0 ; j < 1<<(w*2) ; j++) {
                if (dp[i][j] != MAX) {
                    for (int res : result) {
                        int next = (res | j);
                        int nextn = next >> w;
                        int add = Integer.bitCount(next & ((1<<w) - 1));
                        dp[i+1][nextn] = Math.min(dp[i+1][nextn], dp[i][j] + add);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        int answer = MAX;
        for (int j = 0 ; j < 1<<(w*2) ; j++) {
            answer = Math.min(answer, dp[h][j] + Integer.bitCount(j));
        }
        System.out.println(h * w - answer);
    }
}
